title: Kamailio HA With Dispatcher And DMQ Modules
html:
Another very interesting blog post published recently by the folks at Wazo project: “Achieving high availability for Kamailio with dispatcher and dmq modules”. You can read the full article at:

  • https://wazo-platform.org/blog/kamailio-ha-dispatcher-and-dmq

Dispatcher can be used to ensure the reliability of SIP routing, with options to re-route traffic on next node unavailability, while DMQ solves the needs for sharing data and states between Kamailio nodes.

Should you be aware of similar article that you think worth sharing, let us know and we will gladly publish news about it.

Thanks for flying Kamailio!

Looking forward to meeting many of you at the 8th edition of Kamailio World Conference, April 27-29, 2020, in Berlin, Germany!
